answer: Tie each agent's earning power to a staked work history that cannot be cloned. A newcomer starts on the lowest terrace: it may only take small tasks, and every finished job is re-run by a random peer before it pays. Climbing to the next terrace takes weeks of verified output, so a sybil swarm must buy each fake a real track record. Old standing is not a relic that lasts forever; it decays unless renewed, and a violet flag marks any identity whose re-runs disagree, freezing its stake.
